method.common_state: Each mode replays captured column thermodynamics/gases and uses the captured seed sequence; B/B_now conserve grid-mean mass where CF>0 and report mass omitted at CF=0; C is deliberately non-mass-preserving.
method.delta_policy: SW-only policies 1 D(C)+D(P), 2 C+D(P), 3 D(C+P); LW evaluated once using the unchanged path.
method.graupel_as_snow: Explicit diagnostic counterfactual only, mapping GWP_GRID into SWP using native RES; no public graupel coefficients were independently verified.
